User Reviews

★★★★☆ 2020-11-13
Need assistance from an expert .
I’m not the kind of person to EVER write a review . So count this as serious please. It’s so rare but Literally love the game, been playing it for quite a few years now and this game seems to not fail in how good it keeps on getting BUT there’s also a few other catches that bother me for instance of how much data it consumes after just a single battle and despite having unlimited data and good signal is still decides to boot me out and it gets so frustrating. Also after this new update I’ve questioned if it’s a bug that literally when I try to send team recruitment nothing seems to appear like if no one is in my server despite that I play in one of the biggest servers in North America. Once I logged in like 3 or sometimes 1 team recruitment appear in my log but after that I get NONE. I’ve tried to restart the game and log out but did not help. It’s so boring not being able to find other global people to play with so that’s probably one of the reasons why I haven’t played much and having a bunch of bugs. They have done a pretty good job with hackers but also count the people that try to kill you in the matches and still deducts points but anyways enough with the rant but There’s no doubt for the 5 star rating but this makes me just to turn down one star in the performance that has been going lately with my account. I play in IPhone 11 Pro so I doubt that is my device. Support from a specialist will be great at this point, atleast if they count me in .
★★★★★ 2018-11-07
Fun game, needs minor changes
My biggest issue with the game is that I normally can't find anyone who speaks the same language as me, so it's harder to communicate in game play. I think there should be an option where we can choose to play with people who are only from our country/speak the same language. I know there's already the option of finding people who speak the same language, but that's also iffy because you can't choose both languages to be whatever language you speak. For example i only speak english and i have to choose to find people who speak english and one other different language. That's just something that irks me because I don't know any other languages and there's no way to put it so I can be with those who only speak english as well. Another thing I think should be added is how the footsteps sound. I think there should be a sort of perk we can find where it silences your footsteps, but the enemy can still see the footsteps on the map, just can't hear them. It's still an advantage for both parties. Another thing is with the cars, I think there should be more window security because you can easily be shot through the car with no windows.. and that's no fun right? I also think when you find a car you should be able to have a gas can right next to it because finding a gas can in a house is pretty hard. And I think there could be different models of cars added! Like a truck for example. That's just what I think though! I hope this can be seen and taken into consideration, thank you!
★★★★★ 2023-12-03
I LOVE PUBG
So I’ve played PUBG (counting console and mobile) for nearly 4 years and I’ve loved every minute of playing! PUBG is such a fun game to play either by yourself or with friends. I’m such a big PUBG fan that I bought a poster and keychains of it! I love how realistic the gameplay is, and the graphics are amazing. Like I said in the title, I LOVE PUBG! —— Edit: I received a developer response, and I noticed it said to give out some suggestions for PUBG, and I couldn’t really come up with much besides one little problem. The “problem” I have with PUBG is the recovery time from walk to sprint, like when I open a door or mantle then I get stuck in walk for a minute. Honestly I don’t know if it’s just me and I’m doing something wrong with the controls, but with games say like Warface (which is kind of similar vaulting wise) I don’t have the same problem after I mantle/vault. I understand Warface is not PUBG, but I would love it if the vaulting and mantling was the same. Update: I’m so sorry for the complaint about the recovery sprint time, I had the idea to turn up a setting that allows me to sprint just like I wanted and it worked. 5 stars PUBG!——Update: Please help, I deleted PUBG Mobile to free up some storage, and when I redownloaded it I had no data. I don’t know if I played with a guest account the whole time, but I remember that I had some good cosmetics. Also my profile says I first played two months ago, and I really first played PUBG mobile four years ago. PLEASE help,
★★★★★ 2023-05-22
Great, but could be better!
This is probably the best mobile game I have. I do, however, have suggestions on how to make it better! In the arena, with the 4v4’s, and the 8v8’s, there should be more maps. Especially for 8v8(I think there are two right now) also, put benches with extra ammo, because, in arena, unless you do the weird workshop one, with the guns on the benches, once you run out, you’re out! You gotta die to get more ammo. The ammo dropped by someone who has died disappears, after like, 5 seconds I think. So add ammo benches (no guns! JUST AMMO!) also, I think there are some guns missing from the benches, in that mode. Couldn’t find the m24 sniper, and also don’t think I could find the shotguns. So maybe redo the organization? Maybe a bench or two for attachments(scopes, muzzles, grips, stocks, and mags) and then a bench for the snipers, one for the SMGs, and one for the ARs, and another for shotguns. (Not sure if I missed anything, but I think you get the point.) EDIT: ONE OTHER THING: I have issues in matchmaking, with language. I only speak English, but I am rarely in a match, in a team, with other English speakers! The reason for this, by my guess, is the language selection. I select English for primary. I cannot select English for secondary, or put “none” instead, I have to put English primary, and leave secondary BLANK, which I’m pretty sure is what’s causing the issue! My suggestion? Add a selection to the secondary language labeled “none”, so that I can be matched with squads that I can communicate with!
